svg.aria-label: Three hosts: a browser machine tunnels over encrypted SSH to the trex-web-gui backend host, which reaches the TRex server on a third host over unencrypted, unauthenticated ZMQ on ports 4501 and 4500.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dedicated backend host: browser, backend and TRex on three machines

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Browser-to-backend traffic is SSH-encrypted, but TRex control crosses the network in the clear: ZMQ on 4501/4500 has no encryption or

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: authentication. Use it only on a trusted test network, when the backend needs a display (Wireshark) or a management host.
